# 163 导航页
> A Chinese web navigation portal that organizes links to common internet services and websites.

This site appears to function primarily as a start page or navigation hub rather than a documentation-driven product site. The available public structure is limited, so this file captures the homepage and the externally referenced regulatory link.

## Main
- [首页](https://nease.net/): Main navigation homepage for accessing categorized web links and portal content.

## Site Information
- [ICP备案信息](http://beian.miit.gov.cn): Official Chinese MIIT ICP filing lookup referenced from the site footer.
